description: This file appears to be a PHP source file designed to test the integration with GitLab APIs. It sets up configuration for connecting to different GitLab instances, creates an interface object, retrieves repository file trees, and outputs the results. It includes comments explaining how to configure the testing parameters and utilizes external classes/methods such as 'gitlabrestInterface' and its methods.

classes.name: gitlabrestInterface
classes.description: A class used to interface with the GitLab REST API, providing methods to retrieve repository information and configuration.

methods.name: getCfg
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration object containing project identifier, test script path, and other settings.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns an API client instance used for communicating with the GitLab API.
